title: Single-egress-stair (SES) residential buildings: alternative-solution route under Division A and variance refusal grounds
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: October 2026 (platform created October 5, 2026, last updated October 5, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies that NBC(AE) compliance for a single-egress-stair building can be achieved through alternative solutions (variance) that achieve at least the minimum Division B performance for the relevant objectives and functional statements.
Alternative solutions are a valid method of demonstrating compliance with NBC(AE), as per Sentence 1.2.1.1.(1) of Division A.

A building SCO may refuse to issue a variance for an alternative-solution application for reasons including insufficient or incomplete information, incorrect inputs or assumptions, or an intent not demonstrated in the analysis.
The Discussion notes that prescriptive SES requirements are being sought for a future edition, and that until then designers use two egress stairs or an alternative solution.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
Joint Building/Fire interpretation (Oct 2026). Most directly relevant to the alternative-solution path, but still a regulator's statement of route, not an accepted SES design.
